title: Request a valuation
intro: Tell us about your item and add a few photographs. It takes about five minutes, and there is no charge.
nextSteps: A specialist reviews your photographs and description.
We reply to let you know whether the item suits one of our auctions, with a provisional estimate.
If you decide to sell, we arrange the next steps with you.
notes: Estimates given from photographs are subject to valuation first hand.
The property must belong to the person requesting the valuation, or to their registered agent.
We do not authenticate items, and give no warranty as to origin, provenance, condition, date, age, value or authenticity.
notesFooter: Fees and the selling process are explained on [Sell With Us](/sell).
